## Invitations

A total of 1821 invitations were issued during the reporting period. Attendance was 991, representing a rate of 54.4 per cent. The figures provide a summary of the response to the outreach activity and indicate the proportion of invited people who attended.

Attendance tends to dip in winter and recover in spring. This seasonal pattern should be considered when reviewing participation and planning future outreach activity. The attendance information should be read alongside the contact activity, including the use of SMS and reminders.

## Contact

SMS contact reached 1553 invitees. Reminders went to 0. These figures record the communication methods used in support of the invitations and provide context for interpreting attendance. SMS was therefore the main recorded contact method, while no reminders were sent during the period covered by this report.
